courier.note: The cost is the municipality's courier tariff in force when the order was created (USD). The difference only compares orders with a recorded tariff (charged with tariff minus cost); if none has one it shows n/a. Municipalities without a tariff are shown as without tariff, not as zero cost. Orders from before recording was activated show as without tariff; orders after that date that have a zone but no record (possible recording failure) are counted separately. Active orders only. Amounts in USD, no conversion.

stockPolicy.title: Stock reservation policy
stockPolicy.intro: Sets how long an order may hold reserved stock without progressing, and how many open pending orders each customer may have. Changes apply to new reservations and to the next run of the automatic cleanup.

unpaid.label: Orders without proof (hours)
unpaid.help: Orders with no payment proof or a rejected payment: after these hours they are cancelled automatically and the stock returns to inventory.

proof.label: Orders with unreviewed proof (hours)
proof.help: Orders with an uploaded proof that nobody validated or rejected: after these hours they are cancelled automatically and the stock returns to inventory. It cannot be lower than the window for orders without proof.

maxOpen.label: Maximum open reservations per customer
maxOpen.help: When a customer already has this many pending orders holding stock, the next order is refused and cancelled automatically. This stops a single account from locking the inventory.

errors.range: Must be a whole number between {min} and {max}.
errors.belowUnpaid: It cannot be lower than the window for orders without proof.

stockPolicy.scheduleNote: A scheduled task runs every hour and applies these values by cancelling expired orders and returning their stock. If the schedule is not active in the database, expiry does not run even if you save these values.
